answer: Each funding key gets one work quota on the knoll board, tracked on the basalt ledger. Each unit earns a whisper-signed receipt, and units beyond the quota earn nothing. One honest identity alone uses the full 100 units per epoch. A farm funding 1,000 fakes from one key shares the same 100 units, so the k-th fake cuts each share to 100/k units. Buying extra quota costs 50 credits per unit, so full throughput for 1,000 fakes costs 5,000,000 credits. Auditors recheck the basalt ledger; a quota-rental ring fails because receipts bind to one funding key and cannot move to another quota.
